trigger: Offline ProviderAttemptRecorder reconciliation reports provider raw evidence digest mismatch in all six trial directories. REDACTIONS.json shows the redactor rewrote JSON-like .bin files under ledger/raw before their original bytes were retained elsewhere.
finding: The recorded before/after SHA-256 values prove which stored files were transformed, but hashes cannot restore the original provider/MCP raw bytes. Full raw custody and token-to-ledger reconciliation therefore fail the preregistered decision rule.
correction_for_future_runs: privacy_redact now skips ledger/raw and all .bin files; a focused unit test asserts raw-byte immutability and valid nested JSON redaction. No existing outcome or artifact is replaced.
study_decision: P09 is not a preregistered full pass. Retain the six independently observed task-effect/release outcomes and descriptive paired measurements, but classify the study as incomplete for raw custody and end-to-end qualification.
